title: Saudia-Style Stir Fry with Juicy Delight
description: A flavorful and quick saudia-inspired stir fry made with juicy delights, onions, and saudia spices. Serve hot over rice for a delicious meal.

ingredients.name: Oil
ingredients.notes: any oil with high smoke point

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced juicy delight and cook for 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Stir in the saudia and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
